newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: SAfrican robbers steal 50 guns from police station.
newsitem.headline: SAfrican robbers steal 50 guns from police station.

text.p: Thieves raided an exhibit room in a police station east of Johannesburg at the weekend and made off with more than 50 guns, including assault rifles and shotguns, police said on Wednesday.
A police spokesman said the thieves gained entry to the room by forcing open a window and door at the Actonville police station.
Opperman said 10 shotguns, two AK-47 assault rifles and 40 handguns were among the weapons stolen.
He said police were reviewing security arrangements at police stations which had been scaled down after South Africa's all-race elections in 1994 to make the image of the force more friendly.
But since then crime has soared and police have declared war on violent offenders, but officers complain of a lack of resources and staff.
"We wanted to be more community-orientated but now unfortunately it has become clear that people are misusing this," the spokesman said.
